subject: The 8pm treat that backfires
preview_text: Everyone thinks this works. It actually reverses weight loss. Here's the truth.
body_paragraphs: You know that 8pm ritual—a little cookie before bed, just to make them happy. I used to do it too. Until I learned that one 'innocent' treat can undo an entire day of progress. Everyone thinks a tiny snack at night is harmless. It's not.

Here's the science: dogs' metabolisms slow down when they sleep. That late-night treat—even a low-cal one—gets stored as fat instead of burned. I've seen dogs on perfect meal plans stall because of this one habit. 110+ dogs later, the pattern is undeniable.

PupShape has a treat calorie calculator built in. Open the app, tap 'Treat Tracker,' and log that 8pm cookie. You'll see exactly how it fits (or doesn't) into your dog's daily calorie budget. It's not about guilt—it's about knowing where you stand.

Try it tonight: log that treat before you give it. The app will show you the real impact in seconds. P.S. Most dogs lose 15% of their weight in 8 weeks when they cut the 8pm treat. Your pup can be next.
